demo.title: slate.txt
demo.code:
You: How is the SLATE4 index fund doing?
Agent: (reads NAV per share, current vs target weights and feed health from the pinned fund contract on Base, and says plainly that it is experimental and unaudited)
You: Can it be rebalanced right now?
Agent: (calls rebalanceStatus() and reports the reason and next eligible time)

setup: Ask: How is the SLATE4 index fund doing?
Read fund state by conversation; deposits and rebalances go through the Slate app
